semantics.clock: All sequential updates on posedge clk. Sample in at this edge when reset is low.
semantics.reset: Active-high asynchronous reset on posedge areset; reset has priority while asserted and sets state A. Deassertion alone does not change state.
semantics.initialization: No specified power-up state before reset; no initial block required.
semantics.output: Moore combinational decode: out=1 exactly in D, otherwise 0. Input changes between clock edges do not change out. State/output reflect transitions after sequential update settles.

numeric.input_output: Single-bit logic; legal inputs are 0 and 1.
numeric.state: Four abstract states, representable with two bits; encoding is implementation private.
numeric.arithmetic: No arithmetic, rounding, saturation, overflow or signed numeric operations.

verification.oracle: Independent testbench integer state with direct table lookups derived solely from problem. Compare external out with state==D after each edge.
verification.sequences: Enumerate all 256 eight-bit input sequences from reset; cover every state/input transition.
verification.reset: Assert between clock edges from every reachable state; check immediate output zero, held reset across a clock edge, and release without state advancement.
verification.moore: Toggle in between rising edges and check output unchanged.
verification.execution: Icarus -g2012 explicit dev_tb top; finite compile and simulation timeouts; testbench watchdog and clear PASS/FAIL.

specification_ambiguities: Power-up state before an asynchronous reset event is unspecified. Input X/Z behavior is unspecified; development tests use binary inputs.
